name: Minicurso SSCAD 2026: Tenstorrent com TT-Metalium
description: Code for the SSCAD 2026 short course "Arquitetura Tenstorrent e programação com TT-Metalium" (in Portuguese). The chapter's listings are extracted straight from this repository, and everything runs on the ttsim Wormhole simulator inside a Docker Compose setup, so no hardware is needed to follow along.
